note: Known fixes for review findings that keep coming back. `review_match` maps a review comment's first line to an entry (used by `rex.py mine`); `detector` finds the same defect in a local diff before push (used by `rex.py scan`). Add an entry only for a finding that recurs on 3+ PRs and has one agreed fix. `evidence` is rewritten by `rex.py mine --write-evidence`.

entries.title: Third-party action not pinned to a full commit SHA
review_match: Unpinned tag for a non-immutable Action
entries.known_fix: Pin to the full 40-character commit SHA with a version comment: `uses: owner/action@<sha> # vX.Y.Z` (`gh api repos/<owner>/<action>/commits/<tag> --jq .sha`).

entries.title: Import block is unsorted
review_match: Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
entries.known_fix: `ruff check --select I001 --fix <file>`

entries.title: Unused import
entries.known_fix: Remove the import, or `ruff check --select F401 --fix <file>`. For an availability probe use `importlib.util.find_spec`.

entries.title: Shebang present but file is not executable
review_match: Shebang is present but file is not executable
entries.known_fix: Either `git update-index --chmod=+x <file>` (it is a script) or delete the `#!` line (it is a module).

entries.title: Module imported with both `import` and `from ... import`
review_match: Module is imported with 'import' and 'import from'
entries.known_fix: Use one form per module: keep `import x` and write `x.name`, or keep `from x import name` only.

entries.title: Workflow has no `permissions:` block
entries.known_fix: Add a top-level `permissions: {contents: read}` and widen per job only where a job needs it.

entries.title: Empty `except` or blind `except Exception`
entries.known_fix: Catch the specific exception you expect, and log or re-raise; never `except: pass`.

entries.title: Subprocess with `shell=True` or without `check=`
entries.known_fix: Pass an argument list with `shell=False`, and state `check=True` or `check=False` explicitly.

entries.title: XML parsed with the standard library instead of defusedxml
review_match: Using xml to parse untrusted data
entries.known_fix: Parse untrusted XML with `defusedxml.ElementTree` (same API).

entries.title: Insecure hash (sha1 / md5) without `usedforsecurity=False`
review_match: Use of weak MD5, MD4, or SHA1 hash
Probable use of insecure hash functions
entries.known_fix: Use `hashlib.sha256`, or pass `usedforsecurity=False` where sha1 is a content id (git blob ids).

entries.title: Modernise datetime and imports (`datetime.UTC`, deprecated imports, tz replace)
review_match: Unnecessary timezone replacement with zero offset
entries.known_fix: `ruff check --select UP017,UP035,FURB162 --fix <file>`; only where the declared runtime is >= 3.11.

entries.title: `isinstance` check that raises the wrong exception type
entries.known_fix: Raise `TypeError` (not `ValueError`) after a failed type check.

entries.title: Unused local variable, nested `with`, unclosed file
review_match: is assigned to but never used
entries.known_fix: Drop the variable (or name it `_`), merge the `with` statements, open files in a `with` block.

entries.title: Implicit string concatenation (often a missing comma in a list)
review_match: Implicit string concatenation in a list
entries.known_fix: Add the missing comma, or wrap an intended concatenation in parentheses on one line.

entries.title: Workflow changed but the governed workflow inventory was not regenerated
entries.known_fix: `python ci/governance/audit_ci_workflows.py --markdown-output docs/ci/WORKFLOW_RATIONALIZATION.md`, then commit it (CI runs it with `--check`).

entries.title: File whose git OID JADE outputs pin changed without regenerating JADE
entries.known_fix: Re-run the JADE DAG generator (`mission-control/jade_temple/tools/cicd_dag.py`) and commit the regenerated outputs.

entries.title: `write_text` without `newline=` (CRLF on Windows breaks byte-pinned outputs)
entries.known_fix: Pass `newline="\n"` (and `encoding="utf-8"`) to `write_text` for every generated file.

entries.title: Syntax newer than the declared runtime (for example PEP 701 nested f-string quotes)
review_match: Cannot reuse outer quote character in f-strings
entries.known_fix: Rewrite for the declared runtime (`.python-version` / CI matrix): hoist the inner expression into a variable.

entries.title: `assert` used for a runtime check (Bandit B101)
entries.known_fix: Outside tests, replace `assert` with an explicit check that raises. Inside tests B101 is noise: exclude test paths from the Bandit scan once (`exclude_dirs` / `skips: [B101]` for tests) instead of answering each comment.

entries.title: Subprocess with a partial executable path or unchecked input (Bandit B404/B603/B607)
review_match: security implications associated with the subprocess module
subprocess call - check for execution of untrusted input
Starting a process with a partial executable path
entries.known_fix: Resolve the executable once (`shutil.which`, fail if missing), pass a list of arguments, never interpolate untrusted text; then a reviewed `# noqa: S603` with the reason is acceptable.

entries.title: Style rewrites ruff fixes safely (percent format, `dict()` call)
review_match: Use format specifiers instead of percent format
entries.known_fix: `ruff check --select UP031,C408 --fix <file>`

self_review: Does every receipt or record bind the exact head SHA it describes, and is it rejected when the head moves?
Is every input validated and rejected fail-closed (wrong schema, missing field, wrong repo) instead of defaulted?
Did you regenerate and commit every generated or pinned output this change affects?
Is identity preserved end to end (repo, run id, attempt, head), never derived from a name or a latest lookup?
Does a re-run or a retry give the same result (no latest-wins, no hidden time dependence)?
